title_en: Get up, get up, comrade Aleksovski

lines.en: - Get up, get up, comrade Aleksovski,
Get up, get up, Vasil Aleksovski,

lines.cyr: Да видиш, да видиш твои другари,
lines.lat: Da vidiš, da vidiš tvoi drugari,
lines.en: So you can see, so you can see your comrades,
Your comrades are in the mountains.
They go to the mountains, in the mountains,

lines.cyr: Васил да намере, а Васил го нема.
lines.lat: Vasil da namere, a Vasil go nema.
lines.en: Searching for Vasil, but they cannot find Vasil.
They killed Vasil, they killed him,
The damned fascists have killed Vasil.
Get up, get up, comrade Aleksovski,
Get up, get up, Vasil Aleksovski.

lines.cyr: - Не можа да стана, за да стана,
lines.lat: - Ne moža da stana, za da stana,
lines.en: - I cannot get up, I cannot awaken,

lines.cyr: не можа да стана, куршум ме прениза.
lines.lat: ne moža da stana, kuršum me preniza.
lines.en: I cannot awaken, a bullet has penetrated me.
